queue.progress: R01-R06 established state/evaluator separation, ground-to-space semantics, query-scoped evaluator validity, multi-root Earth references, evidence dependency, per-quantity validity, typed Missing/Unsupported, and split-overlap semantics. R07 locked Takram reference-frame/evaluator architecture. R08 defined typed Weather vertical coordinates. R09 separated coordinate conversion from spatial retarget and split RuntimeCloudPlacement, CloudOpticalClosure and EvaluatorBudget. R10 defined minimum CloudOpticalClosure sufficiency and identified NASA MERRA-2 source-native path optics as a lower-assumption global experiment route. R11 established aggregation/representativeness validity. R12 established query-scoped source capability/lifecycle routing and identified NOAA HRRR as a stronger regional operational microphysics constraint. R13 established the microphysics-to-visible-optics operation boundary and required version-locked MicrophysicsDiagnosticReplay plus separate SpectralOpticalClosure. R14 source-locked HRRR v4.1.20 Thompson calc_effectRad and separated source_locked from runtime_authenticated. R15 closes the remaining source-callpath ambiguity at source/configuration level: the locked CONUS configuration uses mp_physics=28, Registry maps it to THOMPSONAERO, the driver supplies NWFA/NIFA/NWFA2D, and the Thompson presence rule therefore selects is_aerosol_aware=.TRUE. The current official HRRR native inventory exposes the field categories required by calc_effectRad after a typed SPFH specific-humidity -> Qv mixing-ratio adapter, but it does not publish effective-radius outputs even though NCEP GRIB2 can represent EFRCWAT/EFRCICE/EFRSNOW. Therefore real-input replay and independent numerical authentication are distinct: comparing our replay only with itself is not an operational checkpoint. A ReplayAuthenticationLadder and IndependentNumericalCheckpoint contract were added. The R15 semantic probe passed 8/8 with synthetic numerical values. No physical Observation Root was added and no production Mother branch was modified.
